statement: Whenever partition returns a result r, the following holds. Let a_0,...,a_{n-1} be the values of the nodes of head in order, where n = len(head), and let b_0,...,b_{m-1} be the values of the nodes of r in order, where m = len(r). Then m = n and b equals the concatenation of (the subsequence of a consisting of all a_i with a_i < x, in the original order) followed by (the subsequence of a consisting of all a_i with a_i >= x, in the original order). Equivalently, if k is the number of indices i with a_i < x, then b_0,...,b_{k-1} are exactly the entries of a that are < x in their original order, and b_k,...,b_{n-1} are exactly the entries of a that are >= x in their original order.
preconditions: The list head has between 0 and 200 nodes; every node value of head lies in [-100, 100]; and -200 <= x <= 200, viewing x as its integer value.

statement: For every input satisfying the preconditions, partition returns a result r for some List r; it never fails (no Err, panic, or overflow).
preconditions: The list head has between 0 and 200 nodes; every node value of head lies in [-100, 100]; and -200 <= x <= 200, viewing x as its integer value.

statement: Whenever partition returns a result r, len(r) = len(head).
preconditions: The list head has between 0 and 200 nodes; every node value of head lies in [-100, 100]; and -200 <= x <= 200, viewing x as its integer value.

statement: Whenever partition returns a result r, for every integer v, the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(head) and head's i-th node value = v equals the number of indices j with 0 <= j < len(r) and r's j-th node value = v.
preconditions: The list head has between 0 and 200 nodes; every node value of head lies in [-100, 100]; and -200 <= x <= 200, viewing x as its integer value.

statement: Whenever partition returns a result r, there exists an integer k with 0 <= k <= len(r) such that every r's j-th node value with 0 <= j < k is < x, and every r's j-th node value with k <= j < len(r) is >= x.
preconditions: The list head has between 0 and 200 nodes; every node value of head lies in [-100, 100]; and -200 <= x <= 200, viewing x as its integer value.

statement: Whenever partition returns a result r, the subsequence of r consisting of exactly those node values that are < x, in their order in r, is equal to the subsequence of head consisting of exactly those node values that are < x, in their order in head.
preconditions: The list head has between 0 and 200 nodes; every node value of head lies in [-100, 100]; and -200 <= x <= 200, viewing x as its integer value.

statement: Whenever partition returns a result r, the subsequence of r consisting of exactly those node values that are >= x, in their order in r, is equal to the subsequence of head consisting of exactly those node values that are >= x, in their order in head.
preconditions: The list head has between 0 and 200 nodes; every node value of head lies in [-100, 100]; and -200 <= x <= 200, viewing x as its integer value.

statement: Whenever partition returns a result r, the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(head) and head's i-th node value < x equals the number of indices j with 0 <= j < len(r) and r's j-th node value < x.
preconditions: The list head has between 0 and 200 nodes; every node value of head lies in [-100, 100]; and -200 <= x <= 200, viewing x as its integer value.

statement: Whenever partition returns a result r, if there exists at least one node value of head that is < x, then the first node value of r equals the first node value of head that is < x; that is, r's 0-th node value = head's t-th node value, where t is the smallest index with 0 <= t < len(head) and head's t-th node value < x.
preconditions: The list head has between 0 and 200 nodes; every node value of head lies in [-100, 100]; and -200 <= x <= 200, viewing x as its integer value.

statement: Whenever partition returns a result r, if there exists at least one node value of head that is >= x, then the last node value of r equals the last node value of head that is >= x; that is, r's (len(r)-1)-th node value = head's t-th node value, where t is the largest index with 0 <= t < len(head) and head's t-th node value >= x.
preconditions: The list head has between 0 and 200 nodes; every node value of head lies in [-100, 100]; and -200 <= x <= 200, viewing x as its integer value.

statement: Whenever partition returns a result r, if there exists at least one node value of head that is >= x, and k is the number of node values of head that are < x, then r's k-th node value equals the first node value of head that is >= x.
preconditions: The list head has between 0 and 200 nodes; every node value of head lies in [-100, 100]; and -200 <= x <= 200, viewing x as its integer value.
